Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air models still at $200 off (13 and 15-inch all-time lows), but we also spotted this particularly notable deal on this 24GB M5 MacBook Air at $320 off the list ($500 under the 24GB model Amazon sells). From there we move over to Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting at its best price ever (40% off) alongside the base 1TB M5 MacBook Pro back at the $1,499 Amazon all-time low as well as a host of hangover Memorial Day deals on chargers, and more. Head below for a closer look.

Still live: Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air models nearly $200 off for Memorial Day (13 and 15-inch all-time lows)

Today is your last chance at the Amazon Memorial Day deals, and it has now brought back all-time low pricing on the base 15-inch M5 MacBook Air. We are also tracking the all-time low pricing on the 13-inch model to undercut all major retailers, but all four colors on the 15-inch are back at $199 off as well.

Amazon is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $1,049.99 shipped on all four color options.

This is the base model we are featuring here today with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity that regularly carries a $1,299 list price. You’re looking at just shy of $200 off and the best deal we have tracked yet. We caught this same offer starting to go live on select colors late last week, before jumping back up in price on select models, and now returning here again today for Memorial Day proper.

As mentioned above, the additional $50 in savings is now live on both the 13- and 15-inch base models:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $900 (Reg. $1,099) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low

After Apple got rid of the old 256GB storage capacity on the new M5, the base models and most affordable configurations you can buy have become even more compelling if you ask me. The price of entry did go up $100 because of this, but, with today’s deals, you’re getting a more capable machine at a seriously notable price here not much more than two months after release too.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699

This 24GB M5 MacBook Air is $320 off the list right now ($500 under the 24GB model Amazon sells)

Two of the very best deals, Apple or otherwise, this spring are live right now – the most affordable 13-inch and 15-inch 2026 M5 MacBook Air models at just shy of $200 off to deliver the lowest prices we have tracked to date. However, B&H is landing with a special discount on an upgraded 24GB M5 MacBook Air model at $320 off the list price today.

B&H is offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and 512GB of storage capacity in the Midnight colorway down at $1,199 shipped.

This configuration carries a $1,499 list price and is now $300 less than that. Just keep in mind B&H is shipping it here today with Apple’s 35W Dual USB-C Port Power Adapter – configuring this same machine on the Apple site with this charger will run you an additional $20, so today’s deal is actually $320 off.

It is also worth pointing out that Amazon does not sell this particular configuration, and not just because of the upgraded charger option. The only 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air Amazon sells has 1TB of storage and a $1,699 list price (it happens to be $150 off right now though). Here’s a side-by-side look at that one next to today’s B&H offer:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB from $1,199 (Reg. $1,519) | B&H
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699) | Amazon

Clearly you’re getting the double storage with the Amazon config, so there’s no direct comparison here per se. But for folks looking to get up to that 24GB RAM count without spending as much, the $320 price drop at B&H today is a particularly good one.

And for those just looking to land the most affordable M5 Air, Amazon’s deals are the best bet right now:

Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery is sitting at its best price ever right now (40% off)

Alongside the all-time pricing still live on Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air, another of the most notable Memorial Day hangover deals has the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting at its best price ever with 40% in savings at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery at $59 shipped. Regularly $99, it is still sitting at the Amazon all-time low with 40% slashed from the list price to deliver the best deal we have tracked to date. This is indeed the Memorial Day deal so there’s no telling how much longer it will stick around for.

While mostly holding strong at the full $99 for Q4 2025 shortly after release last September alongside iPhone Air, 2026 started to usher in some significant deals. From mid-January through to mid March we saw repeating drops to $80 or so before the May spring sales saw new all-time lows at $60. And now, it is slightly lower for the best deal we have tracked to date.

There are more compact and more affordable options out there, but if you ask me this is the most elegant portable charging solution for iPhone Air users. It does also work with other gear, but it is tailored-made for Apple’s ultra-thin handset, delivering 65% extra battery life and proper iOS battery widget integration in one of the thinnest MagSafe power banks on the market.

Apple’s base 1TB M5 MacBook Pro back at $1,499 Amazon all-time low ($300 off launch price)

Alongside the new all-time lows on Apple’s most affordable M5 MacBook Air – the Memorial Day deals are still live, Amazon has also brought back the base model M5 MacBook Pro at the $1,499 all-time low.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB capacity down at $1,499 shipped. This is matching our previous mention, but after going out of stock at Amazon it has now returned to give folks another shot. This is for the Space Black model, but the Silver is sitting at just $1 more right now.

Regularly $1,699, this is $200 off the list price and matching the lowest we have tracked. This configuration featured here actually started life up at $1,799 when it launched in late 2025, but since Apple got rid of the 512GB storage tier, pricing on the 1TB model here actually dropped $100 – today’s deal is $300 off the launch price and $200 off the current MSRP.

If the MacBook Pro is overkill for your needs, you’ll want to pay close attention to the deals on the base model M5 MacBook Air. Both the 13- and 15-inch models are sitting at Amazon all-time lows still at nearly $200 off the list price:

Longer, faster, and more powerful 240W Beats braided USB-C cables nearly 30% off today

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker 140W 4-port Laptop Charger with smart display is down to $60 low today
  • Anker’s 13-in-1 Nano docking station with built-in removable hub returns to its lowest price at $110 for Memorial Day
  • Rare deals on latest Ring Wired Doorbell Pro live at Amazon lows from $50 (Up to $50 off)
  • Prep for summer swims with up to 40% Beatbot robot pool cleaner savings to return and new low prices starting from $499
  • Ember’s app-controlled Copper Smart Mug is down to just $50 today (New low, $80 off)
  • Elevate your iPhone with UGREEN’s adjustable MagSafe stand for $10 Prime shipped (29% off)
  • These Anker Zolo 50W 4-port USB-C chargers are down to just $12.50 each, grab this 2-pack for $25 today

Most affordable M4 iPad Air models you can buy return to Amazon lows from $520 (Up to $109 off)

While some of the Memorial Day Apple deals have come and gone now, the latest M4 iPad Air lineup is actually seeing the return of all-time low pricing on some of the most affordable configurations. We spotted the base 13-inch hitting a new all-time low at $99 off yesterday (still live), but the 128GB and 256GB 11-inch models have also dropped back to the best prices to date as well.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air down at $519.99 shipped. Regularly $599, that’s $79 off and on par with the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon since release.

Much of the same applies to the 256GB 11-inch model as well. Regularly $699, you’ll now find select colors on this configuration sitting down at $609.99 shipped to match the lowest price we have tracked for this one.

As is usually the case in the early days of the iPad Air launch cycle, the price drops are quite steep on the lesser expensive variants. But we are nonetheless getting another chance at the best deals to date on this two options.

Down below you’ll find an updated rundown of the best deals across the lineup. Those interested in the 13-inch form-actor will want to direct their attention to the two most affordable models – the 128GB is at a new Amazon low at $99 off and the 256GB has returned to its best price at $109 off:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $839 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,019 (Reg. $1,099)
